fdEvidence.error: Error: spawnSync/spawn leaked sentinel above lowered RLIMIT_NOFILE

interpretation: All original 180 observations still pass, including all 10 startup-CLOEXEC cases. This newly tested spawn fallback boundary does not invalidate the earlier startup fix or rewrite its historical passing report.

On four tested ARM64 environments, both lowered-native and lowered-trap fail in both rounds. Native close_range returns ENOSYS on API 28/31/33 or EINVAL on API 35. On the x86_64 AVD, unfiltered close_range succeeds and the lowered-native case passes; forced TRAP exposes the fallback leak.

Each failed case sees the same sentinel file through fd 256 in both toybox children, not merely a reused descriptor number. This is experimental spawn isolation evidence, not proof of an actual production Binder/PFD leak or a security sandbox.

Android fd values at or above 65536 were not exercised: all observed original hard limits are 32768. CLOSE_RANGE_UNSHARE, blocked asynchronous spawn, watch/reload, other threads and other forced-syscall paths remain outside this result.

No new Bun build, runtime patch, official APK replacement, release signing, remote CI dispatch or Release publication occurred. Full experimental Binder, API 29/30/32 and native 16 KiB acceptance remain open.

Next: implement and review a bounded vfork-safe spawn fallback that covers already-open descriptors above a lowered soft limit, fail safely on incomplete operations, lock source/toolchain evidence, reproduce both ABIs twice and rerun this unchanged 20-probe gate.
